column4: cleat#3245 Phase 3 step 2 piece 6b: all four tests open a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) (reapLeaseTestStore), which skips on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone regardless of what else is set -- workflow_leases is PostgreSQL-only (the issue's own scoping decision, same as pieces 1-6a's tests), so none of these four have a MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all four skip here. 4 skips, not a subtest group -- same shape as promise-delivery-updates-the-lease-row.tsv's four.
same four tests, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all four skip here too -- see the multi-db/mysql line above.
